block.field: AI Even Switcher v2 armed — Even/Odd on a 5-tick contract, cadence mode. Sixteen experts forecast P(even) at the settling tick, both sides are priced against the live DIGITEVEN/DIGITODD quotes, and the better expected value wins: the bot buys Even or Odd on every cycle it can read, switching sides when the measurement switches, sizing thin reads down to the exchange minimum. Every skip names its gate; every fifth settlement prints the two-sided forecast and the live quotes, every tenth the self-audit, every twenty-fifth the expert league, the market DNA, the AI core and the reverse engineering.
